headline: Egypt Foreign Reserves Reach Record $57.5 Billion on Higher Holdings
summary: Egypt's foreign reserves rose by $152 million to a record $57.5 billion at the end of October 2026, supported by growing foreign currency holdings.
why: Foreign exchange reserves are a primary indicator of a country's external liquidity, currency stability, and capacity to service external debt.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Higher foreign exchange reserves strengthen Egypt's external financial position.
